subject: Re: AndroidInteraction status: classifier baseline, class imbalance
body:
Csilla, Daniela,

Agreed on the framing — positive-class recall is the headline for the May 11 readout, and I'll say plainly that 0.58 is not shippable.

Decisions:

1. Message-quality eval is cut to a 100-step human rating sample rather than the full set. We don't need message polish while the trigger is wrong.
2. Wei's message-generation work pauses; the trigger classifier gets the capacity instead. Csilla, propose a recall-oriented reweighting and a threshold sweep by May 8.
3. Vision encoder stays out of v1 given tree-only parity.

Ulla
